name: Anja
source:
Anya Tsiklauri is the quiet force behind the resistance, operating in the shadows while others fight on the frontlines. She rarely speaks more than necessary, but when she does, every word is deliberate. A master of logic and deduction, Anya sees people as pieces on a chessboard—assets to be used, threats to be neutralized, and variables to be accounted for.

Despite her reserved nature, she is not a passive observer. She is always listening, always calculating, always five steps ahead. She despises recklessness and emotional outbursts, often clashing with the more passionate members of the group. However, her intelligence and strategic mind make her indispensable.
